notes.crop: Analysis window of the historic study, recovered by cross-correlating segmap.npy boundaries with the angular gradient field of mean.npy (offset row=400, col=100 in all 11 layers).
notes.spacing: User-provided: dz=0.5 um (layer spacing), dy=1.24 um (detector rows, up-down in images), dx=0.4 um (detector columns). Manuscript Table 1 lists (50, 150) nm unbinned; discrepancy flagged in the final report.
notes.channels: mean.npy channel 0 = chi (roll), channel 1 = phi (diffry rocking), degrees; order fixed by darling ID03 defaults ['instrument/chi/value', 'instrument/diffry/data'].
notes.registration: A per-layer shift (x=6.5 px, y=0.4 px, direction=-1) was already applied during layer preparation (processing_info.json); a residual of about -0.55 px/layer along rows remains and is removed by sub-pixel phase correlation in run_preprocess.py.
